description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the canonical config values and correct tiers/config.json — setting workingMemoryDays=7, shortTermMemoryDays=30, maxLearningRounds=50, maxConversations=10, autoCompact=true, compactThreshold=0.7, mergeStrategy='summarize'. (2) Scan memory/tiers/working/ and move files with createdAt older than 7 days (zeta/8d, eta/10d, theta/15d, iota/19d, kappa/29d) to short-term/ while leaving 5 fresh files in place. (3) Scan memory/tiers/short-term/ and move files older than 30 days (memos 002-007) to long-term/ while preserving memo-001 (26d). (4) Enumerate all learning-round-*.json files in memory/, identify the 78 total, and delete the oldest 28 (rounds 1-28) keeping only the most recent 50 (rounds 29-78). (5) Enumerate all conversation-*.json files, identify 23 total, and delete the oldest 13 (conv 0001-0013) keeping only the most recent 10 (conv 0014-0023). (6) Never delete or modify MEMORY.md. (7) Write memory-archive-report.json documenting migrations and deletions performed.
